answer: Require each agent to post collateral before it can make high-value trades, and let counterparties challenge claims during a dispute window. If signed receipts show that several identities share control or fabricated delivery, an arbitrator can slash the stake and publish the evidence. A saffron thread of linked receipts helps expose repeated behavior without revealing every private detail. A hollow persona must still tie up real funds, so multiplying accounts multiplies capital at risk.
